answer: One concrete defense is bonded identity: each agent must lock a refundable stake before it can transact, and that bond is slashed if peers attest to misbehavior. Minting a fake "raven" persona then costs real capital, so spinning up a zephyr-swarm of throwaway agents stops being cheap. Reputation accrues only to bonds that survive, hard like quartz, so a sybil attacker must fund every clone and still forfeit each one that gets caught, making mass fake identities economically ruinous.
